assertions.name: bar_symmetry_identity_holds
assertions.source: Whether every λ, λᵀ pair in the 715-cell catalogue obeys the bar-conjugate identity (with either sign). If yes, the sweep can be halved in compute; if no, the optimization is skipped.

description: Verifies the bar-conjugate identity χ^{λᵀ}(T_β) = ε(β) · χ^λ(T_β)|_{q → −q⁻¹} on the 715-cell derived-χ catalogue. If the identity holds with a stable sign rule, the catalogue sweep can be ~halved in compute.

data.verdict: ★ HOLDS — sign depends on atom (need per-atom rule)
